simple.meaning: כַּעַס (kaʻaç) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to trouble ; by implication, to grieve , rage , be indignant.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 55 times across Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 4:25. Its contexts include family, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּעַס (H3707).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: כַּעַס (kaʻaç) / H3707 is traced through Deuteronomy 4:25, Deuteronomy 9:18, Deuteronomy 31:29, Deuteronomy 32:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
